| Xero | Growing businesses | Excellent |

| FreeAgent | Sole traders | Excellent |
| Sage | Payroll and accounting | Very good |
| Zoho Books | Budget-conscious businesses | Very good |
| FreshBooks | Freelancers | Very good |


## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical UK small business\:

- **Limited company\:** Xero.
- **Sole trader\:** FreeAgent.
- **Growing business with employees\:** Xero or QuickBooks.
